experiment_id.principle: Identifies the exact Exp5330 certificate-gate artifact so downstream self-learning cannot confuse policy promotion with model-weight updates.

field_principles.anytime_certificate_gate_ready: Bare gate true only when promotion decisions are reproducible, no unsafe policy is promoted, no-op controls are cleared, rollback is recorded, tests are recorded, and no model weights mutate.
field_principles.candidate_policy_count: Bare count of candidate lifecycle policy updates evaluated by the certificate.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_target: Bare gate showing the certificate governs continuous self-learning policy promotion rather than static reporting.
field_principles.experiment_id: Identifies the exact Exp5330 certificate-gate artifact so downstream self-learning cannot confuse policy promotion with model-weight updates.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal Exp5330 verdict; starts with complete: or blocked_ and states whether reproducible policy promotion avoided unsafe accepts and model-weight mutation.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic anytime certificate evaluation over fixture rows with no live LLM, API judge, fine-tuning, adapter update, or foundation-weight mutation.
field_principles.milestone: Binds the anytime certificate gate to milestone v486 where context lifecycle policy promotion is the frozen-model SEA target.
field_principles.no_op_control_delta: Bare numeric best improvement delta achieved by the no-op/shuffled control; candidates must clear this delta before any promotion can be reported as improvement.
field_principles.no_weight_mutation: Bare gate confirming the experiment promotes only deterministic lifecycle policy choices and never mutates model weights or adapters.
field_principles.policy_deferrals: Bare count of candidates deferred because bounded evidence was insufficient for safe promotion or rejection.
field_principles.policy_promotions: Bare count of candidates accepted for promotion by the certificate gate.
field_principles.policy_rejections: Bare count of candidates rejected by the certificate gate.
field_principles.rollback_events: Bare count of rejected or later-invalidated promotions that recorded rollback behavior.
field_principles.status: Reports whether candidate policy promotion completed under certificate, no-op-control, rollback, and frozen-model gates.
field_principles.tests_run: Records the exact verification commands used to establish that the certificate module and artifact are stable.
field_principles.unsafe_promotions: Bare count of promoted candidates that accept unsafe fixture rows; value 0 is required for readiness.

fixture_gate.source_honest_verdict: complete: deterministic context-object lifecycle fixture ready for Exp5329 and Exp5330; safe actions commit, unsafe actions reject, rollback succeeds at 1.0, and no model weights mutate

honest_verdict.value: complete: deterministic anytime certificate promoted 1 lifecycle policy, rejected 3, deferred 1, kept unsafe promotions at 0, recorded 2 rollback events, and preserved frozen-model discipline

methodology_note: The anytime certificate is bounded over the fixed Exp5328 fixture. It is a deterministic policy-promotion gate, not a statistical claim about model learning and not a model-weight update.
